options.name: Enclosure
options.concept: Flat ivory lyric surrounded by thick copper protective planes.
options.implementationBasis: Existing .slab planar forms, Archivo/Bebas typography, CSS transform and GSAP scale/translation.

options.name: Word Journey
options.concept: Readable words at separate depth stations, copper portal frames, peripheral falling fragments.
options.implementationBasis: Existing shared perspective world/station camera route, word transforms, slabs and splinters; new arrangement to author after choice.

options.concept: Large copper and ivory lyrics with a curved reveal of supporting wing imagery.
options.implementationBasis: Existing photo layer, gradient reading matte, circle clip-path reveal and image scale; new photographic asset required after choice.
